title: Make your winter trip to Hawaiʻi twice as rewarding with Atmos™ Rewards
summary: Atmos Rewards members can earn double points on eligible Alaska Airlines and Hawaiian Airlines flights between Hawaiʻi and the U.S. continent or Alaska.
body_markdown:
The offer is another way Atmos Rewards brings more value to travel to and from Hawaiʻi, rewarding members for the journeys they


’


re already planning while helping bring their next adventure a little closer.


Atmos Rewards members can register and book travel through


Dec. 31, 2026, for eligible flights from Dec. 1-17, 2026, and Jan. 5-March 10, 2027. The promotion applies to qualifying flights between Hawaiʻi and the U.S. continent or Alaska, with double points awarded on the eligible flight segment that touches Hawaiʻi. Bonus points are redeemable Atmos Rewards points and are not status-qualifying points.


*Book by Dec. 31, 2026. Travel between Dec. 1, 2026 and Dec. 17, 2026 or Jan. 5, 2027 and March 10, 2027. T&Cs apply. Must register at*[www.hawaiianairlines.com/doublehawaii](https://www.hawaiianairlines.com/doublehawaii) .
